title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
authors_zh: Hanane Nour Moussa, Yifei Li, Zhuoyang Li, Yankai Yang, Cheng Tang, Tianshu Zhang, Nesreen K. Ahmed, Ali Payani, Ziru Chen, Huan Sun
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** 565 real scientific discovery tasks binding Docker, data, reference implementations, and automatic evaluators.
565 个真实科学数据发现任务，绑定 Docker、输入数据、参考实现和自动 evaluator。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Scientific data-analysis agents must read real data, reproduce dependencies, and produce domain-meaningful plots or statistics, not merely write code. Existing benchmarks often use static questions or a few manually built environments, limiting training scale, while generic unit tests cannot assess statistical and scientific validity.

D3-Gym automatically recovers tasks, data, and Docker environments from real scientific repositories and synthesizes domain-aware evaluation scripts, creating executable supervision for data-driven discovery.

科学数据分析 agent 不只要写代码，还要读取真实数据、复现实验依赖并产出具有领域意义的图表或统计量。现有 benchmark 常给出静态问答或少量手工环境，难以规模化训练；通用单元测试又无法判断科研产物在统计和学科逻辑上是否合理。

D3-Gym 从真实科学仓库自动恢复任务、数据和 Docker 环境，并为每项任务合成领域相关评测脚本，使数据发现过程获得可执行监督。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: D3-Gym contains 565 tasks from 239 real scientific repositories across four disciplines. Each task includes a natural-language instruction, an executable environment with dependencies, input data and artifact previews, reference code, and an automatically synthesized evaluator. About 6.37K trajectories are also released. The Hugging Face table stores metadata for 565 tasks while images reside in Docker repositories. Thirty-nine source repositories have no stated licence, so downstream use requires separate audit.
D3-Gym 含 565 个任务，来自 239 个真实科学仓库、覆盖四个学科。每个任务包含自然语言指令、预装依赖的执行环境、输入数据与 artifact preview、参考代码和自动评测脚本；另公开约 6.37K 条轨迹。Hugging Face 主表保存 565 条元数据，镜像在 Docker 仓库。39 个来源仓库未声明许可，数据卡仅假设研究使用，因此复用时必须单独审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Discover real tasks: Identify discovery tasks in scientific repositories whose documentation, scripts, and data define inputs, target artifacts, and runnable references.
  1. Recover environments and data: Freeze commits, install dependencies, package Docker images, and preserve input data, artifact previews, and reference code.
  1. Synthesize evaluators: Analyze reference artifacts and domain logic, generate checks for shapes, values, statistics, or files, and repair them through repeated execution.
  1. Validate quality and collect trajectories: Experts create gold verdicts for the automatic evaluators, inconsistent tasks are removed, and agents generate successful and failed training trajectories.

1. 发现真实任务： 从科学仓库的文档、脚本和数据处理中定位具有输入、目标产物和可运行参考实现的 discovery task。
  1. 恢复环境与数据： 固定 commit，安装依赖并打包 Docker；保存输入数据、artifact preview 和参考代码以保证任务可启动。
  1. 合成评测脚本： 分析参考产物和领域逻辑，生成检查形状、数值、统计或文件的 evaluator，并通过多轮执行修复。
  1. 质量验证与采轨迹： 让专家对自动 verdict 做 gold 标注，过滤不一致任务；再运行 agent 收集成功和失败轨迹用于训练。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Automatically synthesized evaluators achieve 87.5% agreement with human gold judgments and strong alignment with domain-specific logic. Training Qwen3 models of several sizes on D3-Gym trajectories improves ScienceAgentBench consistently, including a 7.8-point absolute gain for Qwen3-32B. This supports the environment and evaluator as useful supervision, but the 12.5% disagreement may still reward scientifically invalid artifacts.
自动评测脚本与人工 gold 判断达到 87.5% 一致率，并在领域逻辑上表现出较强对齐。使用 D3-Gym 轨迹训练不同规模 Qwen3 后，ScienceAgentBench 均提升，其中 Qwen3-32B 绝对提高 7.8 点。结果支持环境与 evaluator 可提供训练信号，但 12.5% 分歧仍可能把科学上错误的产物判为成功。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier scientific-agent data are usually manually authored or check only final numbers. D3-Gym automatically extracts tasks from real research repositories and binds reference code, input data, executable environments, and domain-aware evaluators into trainable units. The novelty is the environment-level data factory and scientific-artifact verification, not a new analysis model.
已有科学 agent 数据多由人工定义任务，或只核对最终数值。D3-Gym 的变化是从真实科研仓库自动抽取任务，并把参考代码、输入数据、可执行环境与自动领域 evaluator 绑定为一个可训练单元。新意在环境级数据工厂和科学产物验证，而不是新的分析模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Verifier error: An 87.5% agreement rate leaves meaningful false positives and negatives; high-stakes tasks need human or ensemble evaluation.
  1. Licences and privacy: Thirty-nine repositories lack licence information and real scientific data may have restrictions; the aggregate cannot be assumed freely redistributable.
  1. Environment cost: Images, data, and dependencies are large and age over time. Reproduction must freeze Docker digests, hardware, and numerical tolerances.

1. verifier 误差： 87.5% 人工一致率仍留下明显假阳性/假阴性；高风险任务需人工或多 evaluator 复核。
  1. 许可与隐私： 39 个仓库无许可信息，真实科学数据还可能有使用限制；不能默认聚合数据整体可自由再发布。
  1. 环境成本： 镜像、数据和依赖体积大且会老化；复现需固定 Docker digest、硬件和数值容差。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Scientific-agent SFT: Train data-analysis agents on released trajectories and split by discipline and repository to avoid code-template leakage.
  1. Environment RL: Decompose evaluator outputs into execution, artifact-production, and domain-metric rewards, calibrating human agreement before training.
  1. Factory reuse: Transfer task extraction, environment recovery, and evaluator synthesis to internal research repositories only after authorization and confidentiality checks.

1. 科学 agent SFT： 使用公开轨迹训练数据分析 agent，并按学科和仓库划分，避免相同代码模板跨 split 泄漏。
  1. 环境式 RL： 将 evaluator 输出分解为代码运行、artifact 生成和领域指标 reward，先校准人工一致率再训练。
  1. 数据工厂复用： 把任务抽取—环境恢复—evaluator 合成流程迁移到内部科研仓库，但需先确认数据授权和保密边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: 565 real scientific discovery tasks binding Docker, data, reference implementations, and automatic evaluators.
  1. Method hook: Real-task discovery, environment recovery, domain-evaluator synthesis, and human verdict calibration.
  1. Data hook: The data span 239 repositories and four disciplines with about 6.37K trajectories; 39 repositories lack licences.
  1. Evidence anchor: Evaluators agree with humans at 87.5%, and Qwen3-32B gains 7.8 points on ScienceAgentBench.
  1. Reuse decision: Use it for scientific-agent training after licence and verifier false-positive audits.

1. 一句话定位： 565 个真实科学数据发现任务，绑定 Docker、输入数据、参考实现和自动 evaluator。
  1. 方法抓手： 真实任务发现、环境恢复、领域评测脚本合成和人工 verdict 校准。
  1. 数据抓手： 来自 239 仓库、四学科，另有约 6.37K 轨迹；39 仓库无明确许可。
  1. 证据锚点： evaluator 与人工一致 87.5%，Qwen3-32B 在 ScienceAgentBench 提升 7.8 点。
  1. 复用决定： 适合科学 agent 训练；先审计许可和 verifier 假阳性。
